```artifact
Feature: Alarm System for VTE and O2 Input Line

  Scenario: HIGH VTE alarm triggers when VTE exceeds threshold
    Given the VTE threshold is set to 500 mL
    When the VTE for the current breath is 550 mL
    Then the HIGH VTE alarm should be active

  Scenario Outline: LOW VTE alarm has medium priority
    Given the VTE for the current breath is <vte_value> mL
    When the LOW VTE alarm is triggered
    Then the LOW VTE alarm should have medium priority

    Examples:
      | vte_value |
      | 100       |
      | 200       |
      | 300       |

  Scenario Outline: HIGH VTE alarm has medium priority
    Given the VTE for the current breath is <vte_value> mL
    When the HIGH VTE alarm is triggered
    Then the HIGH VTE alarm should have medium priority

    Examples:
      | vte_value |
      | 550       |
      | 600       |
      | 650       |

  Scenario: GUI computes VTE for each breath
    Given the system is monitoring breaths
    When a new breath is detected
    Then the VTE for the breath should be computed

  Scenario: Pressure high alarm does not re-trigger for 2 minutes after cancellation
    Given the pressure high alarm is active
    When the pressure high alarm is cancelled
    Then the pressure high alarm should not re-trigger for 2 minutes

  Scenario: High-priority alarm triggers when O2 input line is disconnected
    Given the O2 input line is connected
    When the O2 input line is disconnected
    Then a high-priority alarm should be triggered

  Scenario: GUI displays all currently active alarms
    Given the LOW VTE alarm and HIGH VTE alarm are active
    When the GUI displays active alarms
    Then the GUI should display both LOW VTE alarm and HIGH VTE alarm

  Scenario: Event log includes all confirmed alarm settings
    Given the HIGH VTE alarm is confirmed
    When the event log is generated
    Then the event log should include the HIGH VTE alarm confirmation
```
